deployment.tls: Caddy, public ACME certificate, system trust store
deployment.build_policy: Only trusted operator-owned test pipelines. No Docker socket, no privileged builds, no external credentials.

snapshot.consistency: Stop this Compose project and SonarQube before archiving volumes, /etc/craftpulse-ci90 and /opt/craftpulse/ci90. Encrypt the archive with age before transfer.
snapshot.restore: Stop only the two ci90 Compose projects, restore the trusted archive with numeric owners, start both projects and repeat acceptance.py and SonarQube acceptance.
